basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from Toronto, Canada, diving into the world of FIFA Mobile and other gaming arenas. By day, I work as a junior web developer at a local tech startup, but in my free time, I love exploring new mobile games and keeping up with the latest in esports. Not a fan of toxic communities and always up for a friendly match or chat. Usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Recently got engaged to my long-time partner who shares my passion for gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to FIFA Mobile but have been playing video games since I was a kid. I learned most of what I know about FIFA Mobile from online tutorials and watching YouTube videos. My background in web development helps me understand tech topics pretty quickly.
